title: Easygoing American Chicken Casserole
description: A hearty one-pot dish featuring chicken, vegetables, and a rich custard sauce, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This halal-friendly recipe is made with simple ingredients and is easy to prepare.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the custard powder, milk, melted butter, salt, and pepper.
Add the chicken, onion, and carrots to the bowl and stir until they are well coated with the custard mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover it with aluminum foil.
Place the baking dish in a larger pan and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the baking dish.
Bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
